shots.action: At the stone base of the lighthouse, a weathered lighthouse keeper in a heavy dark oilskin coat and wool cap lifts a lit brass hand lamp and starts up the spiral iron staircase. Rain hammers the door behind him and the tower shudders; he takes the first steps upward as the shadowed stairwell opens above him.
shots.what_changes: The keeper moves from standing at the tower base to beginning the climb, drawing the camera up into the stairwell.

shots.action: The keeper climbs higher around the tightening spiral, one gloved hand on the wet iron rail while the hand lamp swings at his side. Through a narrow window lightning strobes and briefly prints the cage of stairs on the curved stone wall; he rounds the last turn toward the lamp-room door.
shots.what_changes: The keeper advances from the lower stair to the lamp-room landing, and lightning briefly reveals the stair structure.

shots.action: In the glass lamp room, the keeper sets the hand lamp down, opens the brass housing, and turns the wick wheel. The cold mantle darkens and trembles as wind-driven rain streaks the panes around him; he strikes a match, cups it, and touches it to the mantle.
shots.what_changes: The keeper moves from carrying the hand lamp to opening the lamp housing and bringing a flame to the mantle.

shots.action: The mantle catches with a soft thump and blooms white. The keeper steps back as the great lens gathers the light and a beam sweeps out through the storm, cutting a turning wedge across the rain; his face is lit from below and the black sea beyond the glass flashes into view.
shots.what_changes: The lamp ignites, the room fills with light, and the beam begins sweeping into the storm.

description.text: At the stone base of the lighthouse, a weathered keeper in a heavy dark oilskin coat and wool cap lifts a lit brass hand lamp from a bench. Rain hammers the door behind him and wind seeps through the iron hinges. He sets one gloved hand on the cold wall and starts up the spiral iron staircase, his boots ringing softly on the treads. The shadowed stairwell rises above him, the lamp throwing a small warm circle across wet stone and riveted iron.
The keeper lifts the lit brass hand lamp and turns toward the spiral stairs.
Rain hammers the door; wind howls through the tower base.
He steps onto the first iron treads, one gloved hand on the stone wall.
The hand lamp casts a small warm circle over wet stone and riveted iron as the stairwell rises into shadow.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

Higher on the spiral, the keeper climbs through a tightening coil of wet iron. One gloved hand slides along the cold rail while the hand lamp swings at his side, its flame guttering behind glass. A narrow window reveals the storm: rain streaks the panes, wind buffets the tower, and iron creaks under his weight. Lightning strobes once, printing the cage of stairs across the curved stone wall. He rounds the last turn toward the lamp-room door, breathing hard.
The keeper climbs higher around the spiral, hand on the wet rail, lamp swinging at his side.
Wind buffets the tower; the iron stair creaks; rain ticks against the narrow window.
Lightning strobes through the window and briefly prints the stair cage on the curved wall.
He rounds the last turn toward the lamp-room door, the hand lamp guttering behind glass.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

In the glass lamp room, the keeper sets the hand lamp on a ledge and opens the brass housing. Cold wind rattles the panes, and rain streaks the curved glass around him. He turns the wick wheel; the mantle trembles, dark and dry. He strikes a match, cups the flame with one hand, and touches it to the mantle. The small flame leans in the draft, then steadies as the keeper shields it with his body.
The keeper sets the hand lamp down and opens the brass lamp housing.
He turns the wick wheel; the cold mantle trembles in the draft.
A metal latch opens, the brass wheel turns, and wind rattles the glass panes.
He strikes a match, cups the flame, and touches it to the mantle.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The mantle catches with a soft thump and blooms white. The keeper steps back as the great lens gathers the light, and the room fills with a pale glow. A beam sweeps out through the rain, cutting a turning wedge across the storm. His face is lit from below; beyond the glass, the black sea flashes into view between sheets of rain. The lamp hums steadily while wind and distant surf press against the tower.
The mantle catches with a soft thump and blooms white, filling the lamp room with pale light.
The keeper steps back as the great lens gathers the light into a beam.
The lamp begins to hum; storm wind and distant surf press against the glass.
A turning beam sweeps through the rain; his face is lit from below and the black sea flashes beyond the glass.
The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.
